questions.question: Why are prompt templates useful in production generative AI systems?

options.text: They permanently change the model weights
They eliminate the need for testing and evaluation
They standardize input structure and make prompts reusable

questions.explanation: Prompt templates provide a consistent structure for inputs, making prompts easier to reuse, maintain, and update across applications. They help enforce best practices and improve reliability in production generative AI systems.

questions.question: Which statement about model size and inference cost is generally true?

options.text: Larger models always produce perfect outputs
Model size has no impact on inference resources
Larger models usually require more compute and cost more to run inference
Smaller models always outperform larger models on complex tasks

questions.explanation: As model size grows, the computational resources, memory requirements, latency, and infrastructure costs for inference typically increase. Organizations often balance capability, latency, and cost when choosing a model.

questions.question: Which AWS database supports vector embeddings using extensions like pgvector?
questions.explanation: Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL supports extensions such as pgvector, enabling storage and similarity search of embedding vectors. This makes it a popular option for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and semantic search applications.
